input.claim_text: On 3 February 2024 there was heavy rain and the creek near our house broke its banks, flooding our backyard and getting into the garage. The garage floor was under about 20cm of water and it ruined a chest freezer and a bunch of boxes we had stored on the floor. We think it'll cost around $2,500 to replace the freezer and the stuff that got wet. Policyholder with AAMI home insurance.

Based on the provided excerpts, here is what the AAMI policies say about flood cover:

**Contents Policy**

Under the "Flood" insured event, AAMI covers loss or damage to contents at the insured address caused by flood during the period of insurance [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44].

However, this cover excludes:
- Loss or damage caused by flood if flood cover has been removed (this limitation will be shown on the certificate of insurance) [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44]
- Loss or damage caused by actions or movements of the sea or storm surge [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44]
- Loss or damage caused by erosion, vibration, subsidence, landslip, landslide, mudslide, collapse, shrinkage, or any other earth movement [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44]
- The cost of cleaning undamaged contents [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44]

**Exception:** Loss or damage to contents caused by a landslide or subsidence is covered if it's proved to have occurred within 72 hours of, and directly because of, flood — provided it wasn't caused by erosion, structural fault, or design fault [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44].

Also excluded from general exclusions in Section 3 (pages 27–41), though the specific contents of that section are not included in these excerpts [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44].

**Building Policy**

Similarly, AAMI covers loss or damage to the building caused by flood [AAMI Building PDS, page 39], with the same core exclusions:
- Flood cover removed (noted on certificate of insurance) [AAMI Building PDS, page 39]
- Actions or movements of the sea or storm surge [AAMI Building PDS, page 39]
- Erosion, vibration, subsidence, landslip, landslide, mudslide, collapse, shrinkage, or other earth movement (with the same 72-hour landslide/subsidence exception as above) [AAMI Building PDS, page 39]

Additional building-specific exclusions:
- Loss or damage to retaining walls, sea walls, revetments, garden borders, and free-standing outdoor walls [AAMI Building PDS, page 39]
- Cracking to sealed paths, roads, and driveways — **except** if washed away by the flood [AAMI Building PDS, page 39]
- Loss or damage to sporting surf

turns.text:
DECISION: approve

The claim is for flood damage (creek breaking its banks after heavy rain) to a chest freezer and stored contents in the garage, estimated at $2,500. AAMI's Contents PDS covers loss or damage to contents caused by flood as a named insured event [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44]. None of the applicable exclusions apply — there's no indication flood cover was removed, and the damage isn't due to sea action/storm surge or earth movement/erosion [AAMI Contents PDS, page 44]. The building-side exclusions around retaining walls, driveways, etc. also aren't relevant here [AAMI Building PDS, page 39].

Using the policyholder's certificate figures (excess $500, coverage limit $50,000), the payout on the $2,500 claim is $2,000 after the excess.
